Sometime after [[4980 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individual [[Dakar Sol]] led a '''rebellion''' against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malachor V]]. Sol's rebellion was the largest of its kind in the entire history of the Empire, though the [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|enslaved individual rebellion]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire came close to the size of the Malachor uprising.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rebellion on Malachor V was first mentioned in the "Rebelling Slaves" Codex entry in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
